Marissa — draft pricing options below. I used the cohort numbers and built a couple of paths: credits-only promo vs credits + reserved.

Option A — Promo credits (no capacity commit):
- 3 x 150K credits = 450K token credits total. List value $4,500 (example).
- Offer: apply credits as pre-paid units to Ignite invoice; overage at standard rate with 25% discount for 90 days.
- Pros: fastest to activate; low risk for us.

Option B — Cohort + 6-month reserved pilot:
- 3 x 150K credits + 6-month reserved capacity at 40% discount vs retail on dedicated pool pricing.
- Offer: 10% additional commercial discount if Ignite signs a 12-month reserved commitment.
- Pros: better unit economics; aligns with product team to prioritize onboarding.

Commercials: see attached pricing grid (embedded in Ignite_QuickProposal.pdf).
Deal tracker: HubSpot DL-2027-1734 created.

Markus — quick legal asks: can we accept a single SOW billed to Ignite covering all three startups, or will procurement insist on per-company POs? If single SOW is permitted, we need a short clause for liability and data isolation.

Quick legal notes:
- Single-SOW: OK, we can bill Ignite for a cohort bundle as long as each participating startup is listed as an authorized sub-recipient and Ignite signs a master pass-through acknowledgment. Procurement may still ask for individual POs — flag that to the customer.
- Data residency / SOC2: we can provide SOC2 Type II plus a completed security questionnaire. For customers requiring a dedicated tenant, we need a separate SOW and a minimal lead time (2–3 weeks) to provision.
- Indemnity & liability: request to cap at fees paid in the prior 12 months; standard for pilot deals.
- Attach redlines to SOW: Ignite_SOW_redlines.docx.

I recommend we offer the credits package with a 90-day overage concession and include a short path to opt into reserved capacity with a clear price table.

-Markus
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference
